description: WP-C7 Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) VENGEFUL SURGE (Shield-Captain, once per battle) through the real enemy_has_shot window. Fixture cus11e_c7_enemy_shoot (P1 Orks' Shooting phase vs P2 Custodes). A real token click selects the Tankbustas, their rokkits are declared at the Shield-Captain with the phase actions the shooting panel sends and resolved by real clicks on Fast Roll / Complete Shooting (the Orks' own post-shot window is declined). The Shield-Captain lost wounds, so P2's enemy_has_shot window offers the Vengeful Surge card (cost 'Ability'); a real click marks the once-per-battle ledger, rolls the D6 (surge of up to D6+2") and opens the surge-move panel; real clicks on Auto-move and Confirm move it toward the Tankbustas. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation; both players have 0 CP (no paid stratagem competes; abilities cost none); the Shield-Captain's wounds inflated.

steps.script:
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
for m in GameState.state.units["U_SHIELD_CAPTAIN_A"].models:
	m["wounds"] = 99
	m["current_wounds"] = 99
return true
steps.comment: setup privilege: auto wound allocation; player(s) 1/2 CP 0 (no paid stratagem competes with the abilities under test) (see description)
